description: Unified unsubscribe record. Consumed by consent_registry cell. Ingests THREE signal classes: (a) explicit unsubscribeRecord emission by member or non-member; (b) AT Proto native `app.bsky.graph.block`; (c) AT Proto native `app.bsky.graph.mute`. G15 STRUCTURAL: per-handle effective immediately at projection layer — mention_dispatcher cell rejects dispatch BEFORE composing post (not after).

unsubscribingHandle.description: AT Proto handle of the unsubscribing party

unsubscribingDid.description: AT Proto DID of the unsubscribing party

unsubscribeKind.description: G15 STRUCTURAL: any of these signals halts dispatch BEFORE composition

scope.description: all-ossekai = complete halt; category-specific = halt only the listed categories; campaign-specific = halt only the referenced campaign

campaignUri.description: Required if scope = campaign-specific; AT-URI of mentionDispatchAttestation being halted

atProtoSourceRecord.description: Required if unsubscribeKind = at-proto-block-ingested OR at-proto-mute-ingested; AT-URI of the source `app.bsky.graph.block` or `app.bsky.graph.mute` record

effectiveImmediatelyAttested.description: G15 STRUCTURAL: const true; consent_registry MUST honor immediately at projection layer — no batching delay / no eventual-consistency excuse

auditAtUtc.description: silenOssekaiReview G14: re-engagement-after-opt-out detection audit timestamp; any post-revokedAtUtc dispatch attempt to this handle is a G14 critical finding
